title: Floating Lantern Garden
description: A surreal vertical composition of numerous colorful spherical lanterns connected by thin stems and surrounded by green leaves, floating against a dark abstract background. The lanterns display varied patterns including grids, dots, and solid colors in shades of orange, red, and blue.
